reconstructability.origin_season_and_hour: Available directly from existing KST timestamps; tested as one new paired hypothesis.
reconstructability.point_rain_and_local_water: Available only where verified observations and known official state overlap; missing windows listed separately.
reconstructability.verified_upstream_trends: No directed gauge/reach or travel-time mapping is used by this pipeline; shared river membership and distance are insufficient.
reconstructability.catchment_rainfall: Nearest-point links are not catchment weights. No verified time-versioned gauge-to-basin weighting was supplied.
reconstructability.dam_release: Gauge flow_rate is not a verified dam-release feed. No verified historical dam-to-target routing/availability mapping was supplied.
